display_title: Enterprise Invoice Processing & Verification (請求書承認・処理)
primary_erp_application: Microsoft Edge (財務会計システム - Financial Accounting Portal)
supporting_documents: Microsoft Word: getsujitsu_teigaku_torihikisaki_ichiran.docx (月次定額取引先一覧)

step_by_step_sop.title: Access Financial Accounting Pending Queue
step_by_step_sop.window_title: 財務会計システム - Profile 1 - Microsoft Edge
step_by_step_sop.action: Operator navigates to the pending invoice table dashboard. Identifies unhandled invoices (e.g., '12 件・10 件未処理').

step_by_step_sop.title: Open Target Invoice Voucher Modal
step_by_step_sop.window_title: 財務会計システム - 請求書詳細
step_by_step_sop.action: Click on row item link [請求書承認 INV-2026-XXXX]. Modal dialog opens showing invoice amount, vendor name (e.g. 北陸部品工業株), and voucher link P6-XXXXXXXX-XXX.

step_by_step_sop.title: Cross-System Context Switch to Word Vendor Master
step_by_step_sop.action: Context switch via Alt+Tab or taskbar. Operator visually searches the vendor master list to check fixed monthly contracted rates, routine vs adjustment clauses, and authorized fee thresholds.
step_by_step_sop.key_element: Word Master Document: 月次定額取引先一覧

step_by_step_sop.title: Contractual Verification & Policy Match
step_by_step_sop.action: Operator verifies that the invoice billing sum matches the registered contract fee (e.g. Global Tech ¥716,232, Hokuriku Parts ¥455,128, Yamato Shoji ¥1,237,439). If 'Adjustment' or mismatch is found, flags for hold.

step_by_step_sop.title: Return to ERP & Paste Audit Confirmation Note
step_by_step_sop.window_title: 財務会計システム and 1 more page - Microsoft Edge
step_by_step_sop.action: Switches back to ERP browser. Clicks confirmation textarea and pastes mandatory 42-character verification statement: '月次定額取引先一覧照合完了・請求金額及び消費税額整合確認済'.
step_by_step_sop.key_element: Textarea: [処理内容・確認コメントを入力してください…]

step_by_step_sop.title: Voucher Numerical Check & Line Reconcile
step_by_step_sop.action: Clicks voucher link [P6-07010448-012] to inspect subtotal, 10% consumption tax breakdown, and withholding tax calculations.

step_by_step_sop.title: Final Authorization & Database Commit
step_by_step_sop.window_title: 財務会計システム - 承認完了
step_by_step_sop.action: Clicks primary action button [承認] (Approve). Backend commits transaction, updates status to '承認済' (Approved), and decrements pending queue counter.

secondary_repeated_tasks.display_title: HR Payroll Deductions Maintenance (給与備考・控除整備)
secondary_repeated_tasks.description: Cross-verification between employee attendance slips, commutation adjustments, and HR master records before payroll finalization.

secondary_repeated_tasks.display_title: Expense Claim Review & Receipt Matching (経費精算承認)
secondary_repeated_tasks.description: Review of travel expense slips and receipts against corporate entertainment & transit limits.
